jobs.description: **Job Title:** Senior ERP Product Architect & Business Systems Auditor **Experience Level:** 10+ Years (Enterprise Resource Planning) **Engagement:** Part-Time / Fractional / Strategic Advisory (10–15 hours/week) **Location:** Remote --- About the Role We are building a next-generation, high-density Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) platform. End-to-End Module Auditing (Frontend & Backend) * Conduct deep functional audits of all core ERP modules: **Accounting & Financials, HR & Payroll, Sales & Marketing, Production & MRP, and Live Tracking & Route Planning**. * Verify that frontend interfaces correctly connect to backend services and accurately reflect real-time business data. * Validate that user workflows support both standard desktop operations (keyboard-friendly, low latency) and complex multi-step processes. #### 2. Universal vs. Industry-Specific Logic Verification * **Universal Core (80%):** Ensure standard enterprise features—General Ledger, Accounts Receivable/Payable, Tax Compliance, Core HRMS, Sales Pipelines, and basic Material Requirements Planning (MRP)—strictly adhere to accounting principles and industry best practices. * **Industry-Specific Layer (20%):** Evaluate specialized features such as: * **Manufacturing & Industrial Processing:** Dimensional pricing (length × width × thickness), glass yield optimization, cut-to-size inventory tracking, machine downtime logging, and detailed breakage analysis. * **HR & Payroll:** Shift-based rotation schedules, piece-rate compensation models, and automated attendance missing-punch reconciliations. * **Logistics & Route Planning:** Vehicle load-capacity balancing, A-frame or fragile cargo dispatching, and multi-stop route optimization. 3. Gap Analysis & Edge-Case Testing * Systematically test the application as different user personas (e.g., CFO, Floor Supervisor, HR Manager, Field Sales Representative). * Identify missing business rules, unhandled edge cases, logical fallacies in financial calculations, and incomplete data models. * Audit multi-branch, multi-company, and role-based data permission controls to prevent data leaks or unauthorized overrides. 4. Developer Direction & Issue Translation * Translate discovered business gaps, functional errors, and missing logic into precise, structured technical tickets (Jira/Trello/GitHub Issues) for frontend and backend engineers. * Conduct weekly sprint reviews and live demos with developers to validate fixes before features are marked complete. --- Required Qualifications 10+ Years of ERP Experience:** Extensive hands-on experience designing, implementing, auditing, or managing enterprise ERP systems (SAP, Oracle EBS/NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Tally, Odoo, or enterprise-grade custom ERPs). Deep Cross-Functional Knowledge:** Mastery over business processes across Accounting/Finance, HRMS, Supply Chain, Manufacturing/MRP, and CRM/Sales. Technical Acumen:** Ability to inspect REST/GraphQL API payloads, database schemas (JSONB / Relational tables), and frontend user flows to diagnose whether an issue stems from UI layout, state management, or backend database logic. * **Complex Data & Unit Handling:** Familiarity with non-standard inventory metrics (e.g., dimensional square-meter/square-foot calculations, scrap/waste percentages, piece-rate tracking). QA & Bug Identification:** Exceptional ability to find edge cases, flawed calculations, and broken user journeys that standard software testers might overlook. Communication:** Clear, concise technical writing skills to document functional specifications and issue tickets for developers. --- Preferred / Bonus Qualifications * Experience with modern web-based ERP architectures (API-first design, microservices, dynamic widget-based dashboards). * Direct experience auditing manufacturing ERPs (glass processing, metal fabrication, or industrial machinery) or high-volume service distribution systems. * Background as a Lead Business Systems Analyst, Solution Architect, or Functional Consultant at a major IT/ERP consulting firm.

We’re looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer with hands-on experience building financial software for the Spanish market.

* Fiscal numbering sequences

* VAT, withholding taxes (IRPF) and different tax scenarios
* Multi-company organizations (holding structures)
* Complete audit trail and document traceability
* Foundations for Verifactu, e-Invoicing and future Spanish regulatory requirements

Every financial document must always be linked to the correct legal entity, fiscal series and accounting context.

Tech Stack

* TypeScript
* Next.js 16
* React 19
* PostgreSQL
* Drizzle ORM
* Redis

Required experience

You have real experience building financial software such as:

* ERP systems
* Accounting platforms
* Invoicing software
* Fintech products
* Business management software

You should already be comfortable with concepts such as:

* Quote → Order/Project → Invoice workflows
* Credit notes
* Fiscal document numbering
* VAT

This role is ideal for someone who has already built serious financial software and understands what users expect from modern platforms like Holded, Sage or Odoo—not just from a coding perspective, but from an accounting and regulatory one as well.

jobs.title: Optimize Proxmox, Docker & Linux Infrastructure
jobs.description: Our stack runs on a mix of Proxmox VMs, bare-metal Linux, and Docker containers that host several resource-intensive workloads (WordPress sites, small AI services, internal tools). Step-by-step summary of what was changed and why, so future maintenance is straightforward. Acceptance criteria • ≥20 % improvement in average response time on WordPress front-end. • Consistent CPU steal time below 3 % on Proxmox hosts during synthetic stress tests. • Network latency between containers on separate nodes <1 ms (internal), <20 ms (external). A detailed 15-element Scope of Work PDF will be provided — bidders must quote per element. - Online lunchbox ordering: rotating 1–4 week menu cycles, prepaid meal plans/credits, school calendar with holiday crediting, per-child ordering with family-code linking (SMS OTP) - Online shop: per-kg meat, variant-priced products, platters; one unified basket; checkout with inline account creation - Payments: Yoco + Sticitt (South African gateways) with webhook-verified payments, refunds, store credit ledger, SA VAT engine, SARS-compliant PDF tax invoices - Donations programme: anonymous sponsored-meals fund with private beneficiary management and weekly allocation engine - Staff back-office (~40 screens): dashboard, product catalogue, learner roster (D6 CSV import), parent/customer admin, orders console, sales insights, daily cash-up - Kitchen operations: weekly branded PDF prep pack with per-child allergen-badged handout sheets; password-gated delivery list - Stock control: immutable stock ledger, live Yoco POS till sync (Sales, Catalogue, Locations APIs), goods receiving, rotating stock-takes, supplier reorder engine - Notifications: 5 scheduled email/SMS digest reports with PDF attachments (Infobip SMS, Resend email), WhatsApp Business template manager, operational alerts - Visual drag-and-drop page editor for non-technical staff; digital signage render pipeline (5 menu boards to MP4) - Brand & design package: logo suite, 2 mascot characters + animations, 35 menu item illustrations, print collateral - Afrikaans-first bilingual (translations supplied), POPIA compliance for children's data - Stack: React + TypeScript, Node.js, tRPC, MySQL, Docker, CI/CD, staging + production, 300+ automated tests on payment/stock/money paths

jobs.title: AI-Powered Universal Lead Generator
jobs.description: I want to build a web-based, AI-driven lead generation platform that works across software services, e-commerce, healthcare and, ultimately, any other major industry I may add later. A user should be able to pick an industry, then narrow results by country and city—North America, Europe, and Asia are my initial focus regions—press one button, and instantly receive a curated list of potential prospects. Core workflow • Industry, country, and city selectors feed an AI engine that gathers, validates, and deduplicates contact data in real time. • Results appear in an in-app table with filters and search. • One click exports everything to Excel (.xlsx). • An integrated email composer lets the user craft outreach messages on the spot, then send through their chosen SMTP or API (Gmail, Outlook, SendGrid, etc.), with basic template management, merge tags, and open/click tracking. Deliverables • Responsive web application (front end + back end) ready for deployment. • Admin dashboard to add new industries or regions without code changes. • Secure user authentication, role management, and activity logging. • Clean, well-documented source code and setup instructions. Acceptance criteria • Lead lists generated for software services, e-commerce, and healthcare in each target region return a minimum 90 % valid email rate, verified through API or internal logic. • Export produces a correctly formatted Excel file matching the on-screen table. • Emails sent from the composer arrive in the inbox (not spam) on at least two major providers during testing. • All critical operations complete within three seconds under a normal workload. Feel free to suggest the best tech stack—whether that involves Python + Django, Node + Express, React, or another modern framework—as long as it remains scalable and maintainable.

jobs.title: Marketplace UI Finishing (Ionic/React)
jobs.description: I’m at the final stretch of launching a mobile + web marketplace built with Ionic React on the front-end and NestJS on the back-end. All core features work; however, the product listing pages still feel rough and are holding back the overall experience. Your mission is to step into the existing repo, tighten up the layout of every product card and detail snippet, and leave the page looking and behaving like a polished, production-ready interface. The priority is the presentation of information—pricing, ratings, stock status, variant options, and calls-to-action must surface clearly and consistently on any screen size. While doing so you’ll be free to adjust styles, spacing, and small interactions, but the underlying data contracts and routes should remain intact. Key expectations • Refactor the listing component(s) in Ionic React to deliver a cleaner, more intuitive product information layout. • Keep performance in mind: lazy-load media assets, limit excessive re-renders, and respect our Lighthouse targets. • Touch NestJS only where necessary to expose or reshape data required by the new layout. • Commit clean, well-documented TypeScript code and brief me through a pull request. Done means 1. New layout renders flawlessly on iOS, Android, and modern browsers. 2. No regression in existing navigation, cart, or checkout flows. 3. Unit tests updated or added for the affected components. 4. A concise hand-off note so the in-house team can extend the pattern elsewhere. The repo lives in GitHub, CI is already wired, and Figma designs are ready for reference. If you thrive on crafting sharp UI in Ionic/React and can move quickly within a NestJS environment, I’d love to collaborate and get this marketplace over the finish line.

jobs.title: OTT Streaming Mobile App Development
jobs.description: I’m building a full-scale OTT service inspired by Zee5 and now need the companion Android and iOS apps engineered from the ground up. The heart of the product is seamless, high-quality video delivery, so the app must comfortably handle both on-demand titles and a lineup of live TV channels with adaptive bitrate streaming, DRM protection and offline download capability where licences allow. Every user will sign in (email, social, or phone) and create individual profiles under the same account, so the codebase has to manage profile switching, watch-history separation and personalised recommendations in the future. Subscriptions will be taken through standard credit/debit card checkout on our server as well as native in-app purchases on Google Play and the App Store; you’ll wire up the respective SDKs, ensure receipt validation and expose subscription status through secure APIs. Key feature set • Video streaming • Live TV • Profile-based user authentication • Payments: Credit/Debit Card & in-app purchases Deliverables 1. Native or cross-platform source code (Kotlin/Swift, Flutter or React Native are all fine if performance targets are met). 2. Integrated player with DRM, subtitles and Chromecast/AirPlay support. 3. Polished UI/UX that mirrors leading OTT standards. 4. End-to-end testing on the latest Android & iOS versions, plus hand-off builds ready for Play Console and App Store Connect. 5. Brief technical documentation and a short handover call so my backend team can maintain future builds. If you’ve shipped a streaming app before and can prove smooth playback at scale, let’s talk timelines and architecture choices.

jobs.title: iOS & Android App Development
jobs.description: I have an app concept that needs to run smoothly on both iOS and Android. I’ll share the draft wireframes and core feature outline once we have an NDA in place; from there, I’d like you to handle everything—refining the UX, building any required backend, coding, testing, and getting the binaries ready for App Store and Google Play submission. You are free to recommend the most efficient stack: native (Swift + Kotlin) or a proven cross-platform framework such as Flutter or React Native, provided performance and maintainability stay front-of-mind. Clean architecture, well-commented code, and clear documentation are essential so my in-house team can take over future updates without friction. Deliverables • Production-ready source code for both platforms • Staging and release builds that pass App Store / Google Play requirements • Brief hand-over guide covering build and deployment steps Once complete I’ll review the build on real devices; acceptance hinges on bug-free operation, design fidelity to the approved mock-ups, and successful store submissions. If your portfolio includes live apps on both platforms, share the links so I can see your past work in action.

jobs.title: Usability & Load Testing SaaS
jobs.description: I’m planning to launch a cloud-based platform that lets product teams run both usability studies and high-volume load tests from the same dashboard. The goal is to give end-to-end insight—from how real users move through a prototype to how the servers behave when 50,000 of those users arrive at once—so the product can be shipped with confidence. What I need built • A multi-tenant SaaS application (web only for this first release) that offers two core modules: – Usability Testing: remote session recording, task completion metrics, heatmaps, screen scraper,participant panel management, highlight-reel video export, and an insights dashboard. – Load Testing: scenario scripting, distributed load generation, real-time KPI charts (latency, error rate, throughput), auto-scaling triggers, and downloadable PDF/CSV reports. - Reporting and Click thru analysis - Ability to support hardware with multi NIC and Multi VPN access in a round robin method to follow timezones based access Key expectations • Clean, modern React or Vue front-end, backed by a scalable API (Node, Django, or similar) and a microservice or serverless architecture for the load-generation engine. • Secure user authentication, role management, and Stripe (or comparable) subscription billing. • CI/CD pipeline on GitHub Actions, GitLab, or similar, with unit/integration tests. • Clear, commented code and minimal vendor lock-in so future engineers can extend the platform. Schedule I’d like a working MVP in roughly four weeks. If we can hit a deployable alpha sooner, even better; I’m open to phased milestones as long as the final hand-off happens within the month. To pitch Show me past work that proves you’ve built either a SaaS platform, a performance-testing engine, or advanced analytics features. Links, screenshots, and brief explanations are perfect—no need for a long proposal deck. I’ll shortlist fast and jump on a call to iron out scope and milestones. To be successful - you need to have done this before and have something already built that can be modified. All visits must pass Google analysis and be counted as regular traffic to be a billable event, thus need traffic profiling and click analysis to be able to be tuned to not be marked "spam traffic"

jobs.title: Reward Ad Platform Development
jobs.description: I’m building a platform where users can watch sponsored videos and earn money in return. The project has two fronts: a responsive web portal and a dedicated Android app that work seamlessly with the same back-end. Core flow • New visitors create an account or log in. • Inside their dashboard they see a queue of ads, watch them, and once the required viewing time elapses the reward is credited. • Earnings accumulate in a user wallet; when the balance reaches a threshold the user can cash out via an integrated payment gateway (PayPal, Stripe, or another widely supported option—you can recommend the best fit). • An admin panel lets me upload/manage ad inventory, set payout rates, monitor user activity, and handle withdrawal requests. • Each user also sees real-time progress: total ads watched, current balance, and payout history. Tech expectations I’m flexible on stack choices, but the solution must be scalable and secure. JWT-based authentication, an SQL or NoSQL database, and a modern front-end framework (React, Vue, or similar) are welcome. For the Android side, Kotlin or Flutter is fine as long as performance is solid. Ad serving can tap into Google Ad Manager or a custom video hosting setup if that’s more efficient. Deliverables 1. Android APK plus Play-Store-ready bundle 2. Fully responsive web app 3. Admin dashboard with role-based access 4. Integrated payment gateway and test accounts 5. Source code in a Git repository with setup instructions 6. Brief documentation covering architecture, database schema, and deployment Acceptance criteria The build will be considered complete once users can register, watch ads, see their rewards update instantly, and request a payout that flows through the live gateway without errors; the admin panel must show matching data in real time. If you have relevant experience in reward-based platforms, advertising APIs, or micropayment systems, I’d love to see your approach and timeline.

jobs.title: Terasnet Responsive Web Build
jobs.description: I need a clean, high-contrast website for my WiFi company, Terasnet, built strictly with HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript so it loads fast and remains easy to maintain. The color palette is black and electric blue, and the layout must scale gracefully from mobile screens to large desktops. Scope and key pages • Home – punchy hero section that instantly explains our service and drives visitors toward the Internet Packages page. • Internet Packages – showcase each plan with clear package details and feature highlights; no pricing table is required, just compelling summaries and “Buy now” calls to action that can be wired later. • About Us – concise Mission and Vision statements that reinforce our brand’s purpose. • Contact – embedded form plus a floating WhatsApp chat button so prospects can reach us instantly. Core requirements • Fully responsive grid or flexbox structure. • Optimized images and lightweight scripts for quick load times. • Semantic HTML5, well-commented CSS, and unobtrusive JavaScript. • Cross-browser testing to guarantee smooth performance on Chrome, Edge, Safari, and Firefox. When you deliver, I want the complete project folder (HTML files, CSS stylesheet, JS file, and asset library) ready to deploy to a standard hosting environment. If this sounds straightforward to you and you can keep the design sharp and modern, let’s get started.

jobs.title: Build a browser automation tool to collect high-engagement Facebook posts
jobs.description: I need a desktop application that helps me research products advertised on Facebook. The tool should: Open Facebook in a browser that I log into. Browse the Facebook feed. Identify posts that meet criteria I specify (for example, sponsored posts or posts with at least 50 comments). Save information from matching posts, such as: Page name Post URL (if available) Comment count Reactions (if available) Images or video links where feasible Export the collected data to Excel or CSV. Include filters such as: Minimum comment count Date found Keywords Run on Windows. The tool should be easy to use and should respect Facebook's terms of service. Preferred technologies: Playwright or Selenium Python or Node.js Simple desktop interface (Electron, Streamlit, or similar)

jobs.title: AI Candidate Recommendation Bot
jobs.description: I need an AI-driven bot that takes the heavy lifting out of recruiting by automatically recommending the best-fit candidates for each open role. The bot’s single, measurable outcome is simple: generate a ranked shortlist so I can move straight to interviews instead of wading through piles of résumés. Here’s the workflow I have in mind. A hiring manager uploads or points the system to application data—CV PDFs, LinkedIn profile links, or any structured form we decide to support. Your model then parses, normalises, and enriches that data, evaluates each applicant against the role description, and returns a clear, ordered list with confidence scores plus a quick justification (skills matched, years of experience, keywords, etc.). Weightings for experience, education, and specific skills must be easy for me to tweak per vacancy, ideally through a small dashboard or config file. While I’m open to the tech stack, Python with libraries such as spaCy, scikit-learn, or OpenAI embeddings feels natural; if you prefer another modern NLP toolkit, just explain why. The bot will ultimately sit behind my existing ATS, so clean RESTful endpoints and concise documentation are a must. Deliverables • End-to-end codebase (data ingestion, ranking engine, API layer) in a private repo • Minimal UI or Postman collection demonstrating the recommendation call and response • Setup guide and a short report explaining model choice, feature engineering, and how to adjust weighting parameters • One feedback round after I test with real candidate data Acceptance criteria: on a supplied sample of 100 applicants, the top-10 list must capture at least 80 % of the candidates manually flagged as “interview-worthy.” If this sounds straightforward for you, tell me how you’ll tackle CV parsing reliability, bias mitigation, and integration into an ATS environment, along with an estimated timeline.

jobs.title: NLP Anonymisation R&D Lead
jobs.description: Project Title Senior Privacy Research Engineer — NLP Anonymisation & De-Identification (R&D Contract) Category / Skills tags Python, Natural Language Processing, Machine Learning, Data Privacy, Algorithm Development, Artificial Intelligence, Research, Named Entity Recognition (NER) Project Type Full-time or heavy part-time contractor engagement. Open to individuals, teams, or agencies — please make clear in your bid who would actually be doing the work and how continuity is maintained if more than one person is involved. Bidders should propose their own rate and estimated timeline based on the scope below. Description We're building a privacy-preserving enterprise AI governance platform (UK patent-pending) and are hiring for the research-critical slice of the build — not integration work, but genuinely novel algorithm development that sits at the core of the platform's patentable value. You'll work directly with the Client's technical lead, who holds final technical authority and personally reviews every deliverable. All communication, before and after award, takes place through the platform. What you'll be working on: - A text scrubbing/obfuscation engine that transforms sensitive text into safe representations, across several distinct operating modes - A multi-pass de-identification protocol (package construction → surrogate evaluation → final acceptance/rehydration), designed so re-identification risk is measurably and provably reduced - Local inference architecture for a privacy-isolated processing tier - Optimisation work for surrogate model nodes - An adversarial red-team test harness to stress-test the above This is real R&D, not a fixed-scope integration job. Several components have already required a full re-estimate once it became clear they were novel algorithms rather than integration tasks — so please size your bid based on the scope description, not an assumed hour count. Deliverables are structured as acceptance-tested “packets,” each with explicit pass/fail criteria agreed up front, so timelines and pricing should reflect genuine research uncertainty rather than a fixed ticket-based estimate. Work packages (scope, not hours): - Research + deep study — architecture annexes, prior art review, threat modeling - Scrubbing/Obfuscation Engine — 5 distinct operating modes - De-Identification Protocol, Pass 1 — package construction - De-Identification Protocol, Pass 2 — surrogate evaluation (expected to be the hardest research segment) - De-Identification Protocol, Pass 3 — acceptance, lock, rehydration, evidence - Local inference — three-tier architecture for a privacy-isolated processing tier - Surrogate optimisation — three sub-nodes - Red-team harness — adversarial testing for the above components Required skills — please only bid if you have genuine, demonstrable experience in most of the following: - Hands-on NLP/text-processing work — named entity recognition, tokenisation, anonymisation/pseudonymisation, or closely adjacent fields (not just general ML or LLM-application experience) - Proven ability to read and implement from dense technical specifications and formal acceptance criteria, rather than working from loosely-defined tickets - Research maturity — comfortable reporting “this didn't work and here's why” rather than forcing a result to look complete - Strong, production-grade Python — including working close to model internals/behaviour, not solely calling third-party APIs - A track record of turning ambiguous, open-ended research problems into shippable, tested code (please reference specific examples in your proposal) - Prior direct exposure to privacy-preserving systems, PII detection, or de-identification techniques is a strong plus, though not a hard requirement Working model: - Async-first; UK/EU working-hours overlap is helpful for review cycles but not mandatory - Direct reporting to and review by the Client's technical lead - AI coding assistance is provided as an acceleration tool but doesn't replace your judgement on research-critical passes - IP: all work delivered under this engagement is owned outright by the Client on completion and payment — not licensed. Please do not propose ongoing licence fees or retained-ownership structures. Process: There is no fixed bidding deadline — we will review bids on a rolling basis as they arrive, and may respond, ask clarifying questions, or close the listing at any point once we have a clear picture of bid quality. Bidders who clearly demonstrate the required skills above may be invited to a short take-home screening task, followed by a technical discussion. The budget shown is indicative only. We will consider proposals above this range where the technical approach and experience justify it — price will be judged on the strength of the proposal relative to the scope, not simply ranked by amount. Please quote what you genuinely believe the work requires, not a figure anchored to the displayed range. To apply: Please include a brief note on directly relevant NLP/privacy-engineering experience, who would actually be doing the work, your estimate of total effort/timeline based on the scope above, and your proposed price (fixed-price or per-work-package preferred).

jobs.title: Scratch Tutor for 8-Year-Old
jobs.description: My 8-year-old son is bursting with ideas for games and animations, and I’d like a patient, upbeat tutor to guide him through Scratch. He is a complete beginner, yet highly motivated, so I want each session to be structured around clear, bite-sized goals that let him finish a small game and feel proud of it. As his confidence grows, I’d also like subtle bridges laid toward future work in Python and robotics, so experience in both areas will be valued. Here is the setup: • Lessons are online, 60–90 minutes, one or two times a week. • Instruction must be in fluent English; Arabic is a welcome bonus. • A calm, encouraging teaching style is essential—please keep concepts simple, fun, and visual. If this sounds like your wheelhouse, send me: 1. A brief introduction about you. 2. Your experience teaching Scratch (and, if relevant, Python or robotics) to kids. 3. Any project samples or a portfolio link. 4. Your hourly rate and weekly availability. I’m ready to get started as soon as we find the right fit, and I look forward to seeing how you can spark his love for coding.

jobs.title: Fix Django Blog Errors
jobs.description: I have a small Django blog project that suddenly stopped working after I moved it to a new environment. What has to be done • Pull the repo, reproduce the errors, and audit settings (INSTALLED_APPS, TEMPLATES, DATABASES, STATIC, etc.) • Restore template discovery so every page renders without exceptions • Resolve all migration issues and ensure `python manage.py migrate` completes on a clean database as well as an existing one • Make sure the Django admin loads, authenticates, and behaves normally • Start the application with `runserver` (or the provided WSGI/ASGI entry point) and confirm zero runtime errors • Hand over a concise report outlining what was broken, what you changed, and any follow-up recommendations Please describe the approach you intend to take to solve the problem in your proposal.

jobs.title: AI-Driven Power Systems Thesis Support
jobs.description: I am preparing my MTech thesis in Electrical Engineering, specifically within the Power Systems domain, and I am taking an AI-based approach to the research for Solar panel MPPT controller. I already have the broad problem statement but now need structured, hands-on assistance to move from concept to a defendable thesis. Your role will cover the critical stages: refining the research objectives, selecting or developing suitable AI models for power-system data, running the necessary simulations, and finally shaping the results into a clear, publication-ready document that meets university guidelines. Preferred tools are Matlab/Simulink or Python with libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch and Pandas, though I am open to alternatives if they better suit the chosen model or dataset. Deliverables • A detailed methodology outlining the AI techniques applied to the power-system problem • Simulation code and test data with clear commenting so I can reproduce the results on my end • Interim result summaries for each major milestone so feedback can be incorporated early • A polished thesis document, formatted to my department’s template, complete with figures, tables, references and plagiarism check report Acceptance criteria • All simulations must run without errors on a standard academic licence or open-source stack • Result discussion must link clearly back to established Power Systems theory and recent AI literature • Final document must be ready for supervisor submission, with citation style fully compliant If you have proven experience applying AI to electrical-power applications and can commit to milestone-based collaboration, let’s get started.

jobs.title: AI Tutor-Matching Platform Development
jobs.description: I run a home-tutoring service that is still matched manually. I now want to move the entire matching process online and power it with AI so students are paired with the right tutor automatically, primarily according to mutual availability. Here is what I need built: • A web-based (or mobile-friendly) portal where tutors and students create profiles and enter their available time slots. • An AI-driven matching engine that cross-checks those slots in real time, ranks the best tutor options, and instantly proposes the match. The logic must favour availability first; secondary factors such as subject fit or ratings can remain configurable for future phases. • A lightweight admin dashboard where I can override or confirm matches, view current sessions, and export data. • Email or in-app notifications to both parties once a match is confirmed, including a simple rescheduling workflow. • Clean, well-commented code and brief technical documentation so my in-house team can maintain or extend the system later. Tech stack is flexible; if you are fluent in Python with frameworks such as Django or FastAPI and comfortable integrating calendar APIs (Google, Outlook) that would be ideal, but I am open to your preferred tools. Please outline the approach you would take to train or fine-tune the matching model, plus any third-party libraries you plan to use. Acceptance criteria 1. A student can sign up, enter availability, and see at least three tutor recommendations sorted by best matching time. 2. A tutor can confirm a proposed match, triggering notifications to both sides. 3. I can log in, view pending, confirmed, and completed sessions on one screen. 4. All core features run smoothly on a hosted test environment that you will provide for review. If this sounds like a project you can own end-to-end, let’s discuss timelines and milestones.

jobs.title: Bba fresher
jobs.description: I’m looking for someone who can turn a raw stack of figures related to the Kerala-based market into clear, usable insights. The material—labels, column headers and many open-ended responses—comes in Malayalam, so the ability to read the language accurately is essential. My own background is in BBA, but I need an experienced hand for the analytics stage. Your core strength should be data analysis; how you get there is up to you, whether that’s Microsoft Excel, SPSS, Python or a mix that suits the size of the job. 2) MOQ Logic Implementation ($70):
Implement minimum order quantity rules on the product and ordering side. Enforce that orders below the defined MOQ threshold are blocked or flagged with a clear message to the user. MOQ values should be configurable per product and enforced at both the UI and backend levels.

Deliverables:
- Backend stock indicator logic with CRM integration.
- Frontend UI showing stock status on relevant product pages.
- MOQ enforcement with per-product configuration and clear user-facing messaging.
- Brief notes explaining what was changed and where.

Timeline: roughly 4 to 6 business days total.

Revisions: up to 2 rounds of revisions per task within original scope, included.

IP and Confidentiality: All code becomes our property upon final payment. Contractor agrees not to share or reuse the codebase or business logic.

jobs.title: HTML Museum Experience Development
jobs.description:
This project is to develop a series of digital interactives for a full Museum fitout.
In New Zealand, the Sports Hall of Fame is building a whole new Museum. These digital expereinces will be containing a large amount of archive images, video and general data.

The content will not be running on a web server. Instead the content will be loaded on to a BrightSign to run locally. This removes a lot of the risk with interne services failing and dependancies on online js packages, etc. So all of the file structures must be fully offline and be able to run on the local file system of a BrightSign.

If expanded features are required, then BrightSigns do support NodeJS. This will allow more complex features if required.

There are 3 main styles of interactive. So all interactives can be based on 1 of 3 templates. These templates will be provided as a wireframe for this project. All wireframes provided will be done by a local NZ consultant. The first phase will be to convert the wireframes into the working templates for the 3 formats of interactive that are being developed. These are relatively simple interactives with in-gallery use on a touchscreen in mind only. These will not be used on a website on mobile devices, etc. Just in-gallery touchscreens. So no dynamic sizing required.

The general structure would be something along the lines that there would be a HTML index page that contains all of the actions. So a single page web app. The text content and reference to images and video will all be contained within a folder and a JSON file. So the HTML file will read the JSON file to pull the text data and which image / video to display. This will make updates and additions in the future very easy as the HTML remains the same, the content only changes.

There is a content specialist who you will work with directly to collect the content.

It will be expected that the sorting and management of the content that is submitted is done by whoever picks up this contract. This is so that the full HTML packages can be collated and downloaded as a full set for BrightSign deployment.

There will be a certain amount of design required. There will also need to be a certain amount of edits that will be requested by the Museum team.

This project is in the process of being signed up as a contract, but and I am preparing the team of support in order to make the tight deadline. I will be reviewing submissions on this project over the course of the next couple of weeks.
Please note: I will not be hiring anyone or any agency that attempts to contact me directly outside of this platform. Please keep all submissions INSIDE UPWORK. I will contact you if / when I have questions or want to discuss further.

This is set as an hourly rate project. However, I do have an upper limit of budget, so time will need to be managed. I will be expecting to see daily progress reports to keep track of the budget.

jobs.title: Shopify Developer wanted – Custom Shipping Logic (Shopify Basic)
jobs.description:
Project Description

I am looking for an experienced Shopify developer who can develop a small custom solution for my webshop.

My webshop sells warehouse shelving. Shipping costs depend on the longest product variant in the order, not on the number of products.

Currently, I use multiple shipping profiles. However, Shopify adds up the shipping costs of different profiles, whereas I specifically want to calculate only the highest shipping rate.

Current Situation
Example:

• Product A (80 cm) → €39 shipping
• Product B (160 cm) → €59 shipping
• Product C (320 cm) → €99 shipping

When a customer orders A + C, Shopify calculates:

€39 + €99 = €138
That is incorrect.

The desired outcome is:

€99
Therefore, only the highest shipping rate is always applied.

How the logistics work
We transport warehouse shelving on pallets.

The longest beams or uprights determine the required pallet length. The remaining products are almost always stacked on the same pallet.

Therefore, in approximately 95% of orders, only the longest length determines the transport costs.

Desired logic
Every product variant has a length.

For example:

80 cm
200 cm
250 cm
320 cm
400 cm
480 cm
The application must:

1. Read all variants in the shopping cart.

2. Determine the greatest length.

3. Select exactly one shipping rate based on that. shipping rates:

jobs.title: Telehealth App Developer Needed
jobs.description:
Hi, I have an idea I want to build and I'm looking for someone who can help turn it into a real product. Here's what I'm thinking.

I want to build a platform that makes it way easier for people to get healthcare when they need it, without all the usual hassle of figuring out which doctor to see, waiting on hold to book an appointment, or filling out the same forms over and over. Basically, someone opens the app, describes what's going on with them, and the app helps guide them to the right kind of care and gets them booked with a provider fast. On the clinic side, I want doctors and staff to have a simple dashboard where they can see their patients, manage appointments, and communicate with them, without drowning in admin work.

The part I'm really excited about is using AI to handle a lot of the repetitive stuff — like asking patients the basic intake questions, doing a first pass at understanding how urgent their issue is, answering common questions patients usually call in about, and sending reminders so people don't miss appointments. If something's more serious or needs a real judgment call, it should hand things off to an actual person, not try to be a replacement for the doctor. I just want it to take the busywork off everyone's plate.

So overall I need a mobile app for patients, a web dashboard for the clinic/providers, and some kind of AI assistant tying it together on the backend. Payments need to be built in too, so people can pay for consultations right through the app. And since it's healthcare, I need whoever builds this to take privacy and security seriously from day one — that's non-negotiable for me.

I don't have this fully spec'd out technically — that's honestly why I'm looking for someone experienced. I have the vision and the problem I'm trying to solve, but I want a developer who can help me make the right calls on how to actually build it, push back if something I'm asking for doesn't make sense, and keep me updated as we go so I'm not left in the dark for weeks at a time. I also want to build this in a way that can grow — I'm thinking about adding more features and bringing on more clinics down the line, so it shouldn't be a one-off hacky build.

Let me know your rate and if this is something you'd be interested in working on with me.

jobs.title: Senior Flutter Developer — 2D Interactive App Engine & 10-Class Pilot (Flutter/Rive)
jobs.description:
I am building a premium 2D interactive educational app for preschoolers, designed to run flawlessly on both mobile phones and tablets.

I need a Senior Flutter developer with deep interactive/canvas experience to build the core application architecture and execute the first 10 AAA-quality lessons. You are setting the gold standard. Once Phase 1 is done, my junior in-house developers will use your templates to build future lessons.

Do not apply if your portfolio is limited to standard UI forms, e-commerce, or utility apps. You must understand 60fps gesture tracking, CustomPaint, extreme aspect ratio scaling, and Rive state machines.

Phase 1: The Global Architecture Shell
You will build the empty engine and reusable templates first.

Dynamic Coordinate Scaling (Phones & Tablets): Program all interaction zones, hitboxes, and bounding boxes using relative screen percentages. Mechanics must not break or render off-screen when shifting from a 4:3 tablet to a 19.5:9 phone.

The 7 Core Mechanic Templates: Write reusable math/logic for: State Toggles, Drag & Target (collisions), Analog Sliders, Mask Reveals, Path Tracing, Tap & Hold, and Physics Spawn.

Local Persistence: Build a local data-saving layer (e.g., Hive) to track lesson completion and costume unlocks without a backend.

Lightweight Particle Emitter: Build a non-physics visual emitter for UI celebrations (confetti, stars) that won't lag older devices.

Global Audio Controller: Architect a strict 3-channel audio system (BGM, Voiceovers, UI SFX) that prevents overlapping and engine lag.

State & Navigation Shell: Build the core routing and progress tracking.

The Rive Animation Bridge: Integrate the Rive runtime to dynamically swap character costume skins via code and trigger randomized global reactions.

Phase 2: The 10-Class Pilot
Once the shell is stable and the illustrator/animator delivers the assets, you will assemble the first 10 complete classes using your templates. These must be perfectly optimized, responsive to all screen sizes, and bug-free.

Requirements:

Expert in Flutter.

Proven ability to build responsive canvas elements that scale dynamically across phones and tablets.

Deep experience with Rive integration and triggering state machines via code.

Proven experience building mobile games, ed-tech apps, or highly interactive custom UIs.

Ability to deliver modular code that junior developers can easily replicate.

To Apply:
Link 1 or 2 projects in your portfolio that specifically show custom gesture tracking, drag-and-drop mechanics, or dynamic 2D animations in Flutter on varying screen sizes. Start your proposal with "Responsive Flutter Engine" so I know you read this.
